source: NITB Freshers portal, 'Examination Scheme for B.Tech Ist Year' (UG Ordinance 2024, Annexure-2) and 'Academic Resources List', both August 2025

mini_test.note: during class hours; sometimes 20 marks; begins in the 1st or 2nd week of the month after the semester starts

mid_term.note: 1 hour exam; generally the month after the mini test

end_term.note: 2 hour exam; about a month after the mid term ends

grading: relative, across all sections of the subject

MC1101: Higher Engineering Mathematics by B.S. Grewal
seniors: study from these once you have seen the PYQs; minor errors in the books do not matter
PY1102: Engineering Physics by H.K. Malik (theory and numericals); otherwise the class notes
CS1105: seniors: looks easy, but the mid and end term questions catch people
HS1106: Effective Technical Communication by Ashraf Rizvi
seniors: write clearly, no grammatical errors, no stories; the questions are easy
ME1104: Engineering Drawing by Basant Agarwal and C.M. Agarwal
seniors: relatively tough this semester; N.D. Bhatt is first-angle only and rarely matches the paper
CE1103: seniors: calculation-heavy paper, use the calculator efficiently
CY1107: Engineering Chemistry by Jain and Jain (preferred)
Engineering Chemistry by Dara and Umare
EE1108: R.K. Rajput (most preferred; about 90% of questions)
B.L. Theraja only for DC circuits
seniors: the end term is the hardest paper of the semester for derivations, theory and numericals
CY1110: class notes and the shared slides only
ME1109: Introduction to Manufacturing Processes and Workshop Technology
BS1111: NCERT class XI and XII for the topics taught in class
